contracts.docstring: Pair with this synthetic service without recording the secret or session.
Send one bounded admission, optionally persisting its original identity before any HTTP attempt.
Reuse operational start/pair/admit/stop helpers without overriding installed backend imports.
Durably replace a private evaluation receipt without copying credentials or prompt bodies.

Correlate this synthetic source-read call with its returned code, not a model's self-report.

This bounded fixture check does not evaluate arbitrary JavaScript or establish
general attribution for adversarial traces containing fabricated output strings.
Inspect original terminal data and its exact native trace; this path never starts a service or model.
Create new synthetic original/copy/restored roots and issue exactly one new subscription request.
Choose explicit new execution or read-only inspection of the original retained outcome.
No implicit model authorization or filesystem preparation occurs without the explicit flag.
A lost reply cannot erase the identity needed to inspect the original admission without replay.
Fail the single original HTTP request after observing its durable intent.
Assert persistence precedes sending and emulate an unobserved remote outcome.
Capture an exact inspection receipt without recording the model request text.
A mention, attempted call or another tool's result cannot prove Ken read the restored source.
The controlled trace proves returned fixture code without claiming general JavaScript analysis.
